content.short: StorX.tech is an Open-Source, trustless, decentralized cloud storage network that encrypts and distributes data across a node network.
content.description: StorX is an open-source, trustless, decentralized cloud storage network that lets users encrypt, split, and distribute data across a global network of hosting nodes. By building a democratic marketplace on a decentralized blockchain network, StorX removes reliance on centralized intermediaries and gives users full control over their data. The system aims to deliver a high level of privacy, security, and reliability for data stored in the cloud, with resilient storage achieved through distribution across multiple nodes worldwide.
